<!-- FINISH GLOBAL SCRIPTS --><!-- ============================================================
     HERO SET PICKER + VISIBILITY CSS + FLICKER FIX + FALLBACK
     — single combined <head> block. Paste into: Webflow →
     Page/Site Settings → Custom Code → "Inside <head> tag".

     ORDER MATTERS inside this block:
       1. The set-picker <script> runs first. It is synchronous, so
          data-hero-set is stamped on <html> BEFORE the first paint —
          every html[data-hero-set=...] selector below can therefore
          match from the very first frame (no flash of all three sets).
       2. The <style> then handles, in three layers:
          a. SET VISIBILITY (unchanged, per breakpoint): only the
             randomly picked set's images + headline are shown; on
             mobile Newton swaps his main image for a mobile variant.
          b. LOAD-ANIMATION PRE-HIDE (flicker fix): elements that
             animate IN on page load are visibility:hidden from the
             first frame, so a hard reload (Cmd+Shift+R) can never
             paint them at their CSS home position before the footer
             script repositions them. The footer script reveals each
             one in the same synchronous step that moves it off-screen.
             These rules sit OUTSIDE the media queries on purpose —
             the animations run on all breakpoints, and inactive sets
             are display:none anyway, so hiding them is harmless.
          c. FALLBACK: if GSAP never loads (CDN outage, blocked JS),
             a 0-duration CSS animation delayed by 2s reveals the
             pre-hidden elements at their normal Webflow position.
             The footer script disarms it by adding class "hero-js"
             to <html> once it has CONFIRMED window.gsap exists.
             No class within 2s = no working script = images simply
             appear, un-animated. Degraded, but never invisible.
             TUNING: 2s is a trade-off — on very slow connections the
             footer script may start after the fallback fired, causing
             one brief flash before the intro replays. If seen on slow
             devices, raise the delay to 2.5s–3s.

     The footer script (before </body>) is unchanged from the
     previous revision and pairs with this block.
     ============================================================ -->

<script>
(function () {
  // Randomly pick one of the three hero sets, avoiding an immediate
  // repeat within the same browser session (sessionStorage-backed).
  // Runs synchronously in the <head> so data-hero-set is present
  // before the first paint — the CSS below depends on that.
  var sets = ['newton', 'einstein', 'franklin'];
  var KEY = 'heroSet:last';
  var last = null;
  try {
    last = sessionStorage.getItem(KEY);
  } catch (e) {}
  function pick(excludeLast) {
    var pool = excludeLast
      ? sets.filter(function (s) {
          return s !== last;
        })
      : sets;
    if (!pool.length) pool = sets;
    return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
  }
  function apply(set) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-hero-set', set);
    last = set;
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, set);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  apply(pick(true));
})();
</script>

<style>
  /* ==============================================================
     LAYER A — SET VISIBILITY (unchanged behaviour)
     Show only the picked set's images + headline per breakpoint.
     ============================================================== */
  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    [data-image-mobile-newton="true"] {
      display: none !important;
    }
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="newton"]) [data-image-newton-anim="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="newton"]) [data-image-newton-anim-main="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="einstein"]) [data-image-einstein-anim="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="einstein"]) [data-image-einstein-anim-main="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="franklin"]) [data-image-franklin-anim="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="franklin"]) [data-image-franklin-anim-main="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="newton"]) [data-hero-headline="newton"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="einstein"]) [data-hero-headline="einstein"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="franklin"]) [data-hero-headline="franklin"] {
      display: none !important;
    }
  }
  @media (max-width: 991px) {
    [data-image-newton-anim-main="true"] {
      display: none !important;
    }
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="newton"]) [data-image-newton-anim="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="newton"]) [data-image-mobile-newton="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="einstein"]) [data-image-einstein-anim="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="einstein"]) [data-image-einstein-anim-main="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="franklin"]) [data-image-franklin-anim="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="franklin"]) [data-image-franklin-anim-main="true"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="newton"]) [data-hero-headline="newton"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="einstein"]) [data-hero-headline="einstein"],
    html[data-hero-set]:not([data-hero-set="franklin"]) [data-hero-headline="franklin"] {
      display: none !important;
    }
    html[data-hero-set="newton"] [data-image-mobile-newton="true"] {
      display: block !important;
    }
  }

  /* ==============================================================
     LAYER B — LOAD-ANIMATION PRE-HIDE (hard-reload flicker fix)
     Only the elements that animate IN on page load, scoped to the
     ACTIVE set. visibility (not display) so layout is preserved and
     the footer script can still measure sizes/positions.
     ============================================================== */
  html[data-hero-set="einstein"] [data-image-einstein-anim="true"],
  html[data-hero-set="einstein"] [data-image-einstein-anim-main="true"],
  html[data-hero-set="franklin"] [data-image-franklin-anim-main="true"] {
    visibility: hidden;
    /* LAYER C — FALLBACK: reveal after 2s in case the script never
       takes over. 0s duration + forwards fill = a delayed, instant
       switch back to visible at the normal Webflow position. */
    animation: hero-reveal-fallback 0s linear 2s forwards;
  }

  /* The footer script stamps this class once GSAP is confirmed
     loaded — kills the fallback so GSAP's inline styles win. */
  html.hero-js [data-image-einstein-anim="true"],
  html.hero-js [data-image-einstein-anim-main="true"],
  html.hero-js [data-image-franklin-anim-main="true"] {
    animation: none;
  }

  @keyframes hero-reveal-fallback {
    to {
      visibility: visible;
    }
  }
</style></head><body class="body-v2"><div class="page-wrapper"><div class="global-styles"><div class="style-overrides w-embed"><style>

class="hero-section-js w-embed w-script"><!-- ============================================================
     Newton + Einstein + Franklin hero — progressive scroll animation
     (GSAP ScrollTrigger)

     Paste this into: Webflow → Page/Site Settings → Custom Code
     → "Before </body> tag" (footer).

     Requires:
       1. the <head> snippet that stamps data-hero-set on <html>;
       2. the <head> <style> block that pre-hides the load-animated
          elements AND contains the 2s no-JS reveal fallback.
     Only the randomly chosen set is animated here — the other two are
     display:none and would measure as 0x0, breaking the distance math.

     NEWTON   → scrubbed to scroll (continuous), starts at the very top.
     FRANKLIN → scrubbed to scroll on the SAME timeline as Newton:
       • data-image-franklin-anim="true"      → fades 40% → 100% during the
                                                first 40% of the scroll range
       • data-image-franklin-anim-main="true" → travels 25% of the way toward
                                                the LEFT edge (partial exit)
       • ON PAGE LOAD (client request): the main Franklin image slides
         slightly to the RIGHT into its home position. Animates xPercent
         while the scroll drives x — the two transform channels compose
         independently in GSAP, so they can never fight.
     EINSTEIN:
       • ON PAGE LOAD (client request): the re-entry intro plays once,
         as long as the hero is still in view when the page loads.
       • Scroll DOWN → EXIT driven by scroll progress through an eased
         follower (smoother than raw scroll):
           data-image-einstein-anim="true"      → rotates -45deg, drops 80%
                                                  down, fades out
           data-image-einstein-anim-main="true" → exits right + rotates -30deg
       • Scroll UP into hero (or first page load) → RE-ENTRY INTRO:
           0.0s  cloud parked off-screen at opacity 0
           0.0s  main image slides in from off-screen left over 3s
           1.5s  cloud flies in from beyond the left edge, fading 0 → 65%

     FALLBACK HANDSHAKE (this revision)
     ----------------------------------
     The <head> CSS pre-hides the load-animated elements and arms a 2s
     "reveal anyway" fallback. This script disarms that fallback by
     adding class "hero-js" to <html> — but ONLY after confirming that
     window.gsap and window.ScrollTrigger actually loaded. If either is
     missing, the script bails out WITHOUT adding the class, the CSS
     fallback fires at 2s, and the images appear at their normal Webflow
     position with no animation. Degraded, but never invisible.

     HARD-RELOAD FLICKER FIX (earlier revision, still active)
     --------------------------------------------------------
     Elements arrive pre-hidden by the head CSS; every code path reveals
     them with a synchronous gsap.set(visibility:'visible') IMMEDIATELY
     AFTER placing them at their animation start position (off-screen /
     nudged left) — same JS task, so no frame can paint in between.

     BUGFIX (cloud flicker on re-entry — earlier revision, still active)
     -------------------------------------------------------------------
     The cloud's intro tween only starts 1.5s in, so it used to sit in a
     leftover exit state and then snap away. It is now parked off-screen
     at opacity 0 at the very start of the intro (and synchronously in
     playEinsteinIntro), and fades in from 0 — it can only ever appear
     as part of its own animation.

     TIMELINE NOTE: the scrubbed timeline's total length is normalised
     onto the scroll range, so duration/position = SHARE of the scroll.
     Total length here is 1, so 0.4 = 40% of the scroll.

     SCROLL RANGE:
       • START — first pixel of scroll (offset by the hero's distance
         from the document top: ~150px of banner + navbar above it).
       • END — after scrolling ~75% of the hero section's own height.
       Both are functions + invalidateOnRefresh → re-measured on resize.
     ============================================================ -->

<!-- GSAP core + ScrollTrigger plugin (free) -->
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // FALLBACK HANDSHAKE: if GSAP or ScrollTrigger failed to load,
    // bail out WITHOUT adding the hero-js class — the head CSS will
    // reveal the images at 2s. Only once both are confirmed present is
    // the fallback disarmed and control taken over.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (!window.gsap || !window.ScrollTrigger) return;
    document.documentElement.classList.add('hero-js');

    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

    var hero = document.querySelector('[data-section-hero="true"]');
    if (!hero) return;

    // Which set did the <head> script pick? Animate only that one —
    // hidden elements measure as 0x0 and would break the distance math.
    var activeSet = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-hero-set') || 'newton';

    function pick(name, selector) {
      return activeSet === name ? hero.querySelector(selector) : null;
    }

    var newton = pick('newton', '[data-image-newton-anim="true"]');
    var newtonMain = pick('newton', '[data-image-newton-anim-main="true"]');
    var einstein = pick('einstein', '[data-image-einstein-anim="true"]'); // the cloud
    var einsteinMain = pick('einstein', '[data-image-einstein-anim-main="true"]');
    var franklin = pick('franklin', '[data-image-franklin-anim="true"]');
    var franklinMain = pick('franklin', '[data-image-franklin-anim-main="true"]');

    if (!newton && !newtonMain && !einstein && !einsteinMain && !franklin && !franklinMain) return;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper: how far the hero's top sits below the document top.
    // At scroll 0 this equals the space taken by the top-banner + navbar
    // above it. Used to offset the ScrollTrigger start so the animation
    // begins at the very first pixel of scroll.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    function heroTopOffset() {
      return Math.round(hero.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset);
    }

    // The cloud's resting opacity, as set in Webflow. The intro must return
    // to THIS value, not to 1, or the image comes back too bright.
    var EINSTEIN_OPACITY = 0.65;

    var einsteinReturning = false; // true while the (load or re-entry) intro is playing

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Park the cloud completely out of sight. Called synchronously the
    // instant an intro is requested, and again as a zero-duration set at
    // position 0 of the intro timeline. y/rotation reset too, so it
    // re-enters level rather than still tilted from the exit.
    // FLICKER FIX: visibility:'visible' is set here — the element arrives
    // pre-hidden by the <head> CSS, and this is the safe moment to reveal
    // it (it is off-screen AND at opacity 0 in the very same set() call).
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    function parkEinsteinCloud() {
      if (!einstein) return;
      gsap.set(einstein, {
        x: -window.innerWidth, // far beyond the left edge
        y: 0,
        rotation: 0,
        opacity: 0, // belt and braces: invisible even if it pokes out
        visibility: 'visible', // ← reveal (pre-hidden by head CSS)
      });
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Einstein EXIT — PAUSED timeline; its progress is driven by hand from
    // the scroll position (see onUpdate). ease:'none' so it maps linearly;
    // all the smoothing comes from the follower further down.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    var einsteinExit = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
    if (einstein) {
      einsteinExit.to(einstein, { y: '80%', rotation: -45, opacity: 0, ease: 'none' }, 0);
    }
    if (einsteinMain) {
      einsteinExit.to(
        einsteinMain,
        {
          // push fully past the RIGHT edge, measured from the CURRENT left
          x: function () {
            return window.innerWidth - einsteinMain.getBoundingClientRect().left + 200;
          },
          rotation: -30,
          ease: 'none',
        },
        0,
      );
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Measure where einsteinMain naturally sits, so the intro knows how far
    // off-screen-left it has to start from. Only measured at rest.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    var mainHomeLeft = 0,
      mainWidth = 0;
    function measureEinsteinMain() {
      if (!einsteinMain || einsteinReturning || einsteinExit.progress() !== 0) return;
      mainWidth = einsteinMain.offsetWidth; // layout width, ignores transforms
      mainHomeLeft = einsteinMain.getBoundingClientRect().left - (parseFloat(gsap.getProperty(einsteinMain, 'x')) || 0);
    }
    measureEinsteinMain();
    window.addEventListener('load', measureEinsteinMain); // images may size late
    window.addEventListener('resize', measureEinsteinMain);

    function offscreenLeftX() {
      // fully past the left edge, + buffer so nothing pokes out at the start
      return -(mainHomeLeft + mainWidth + 200);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Einstein RE-ENTRY / LOAD INTRO. immediateRender:false everywhere
    // keeps the images untouched until this actually plays.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    var einsteinIntro = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
    if (einstein) {
      // FIRST thing the intro does: hide the cloud off-screen. A
      // zero-duration .set() rather than a callback on purpose —
      // restart() suppresses callbacks at time 0 but always renders tweens.
      einsteinIntro.set(
        einstein,
        {
          x: function () {
            return -window.innerWidth;
          },
          y: 0,
          rotation: 0,
          opacity: 0,
          visibility: 'visible', // FLICKER FIX: safe to reveal — off-screen + opacity 0
        },
        0,
      );
    }
    if (einsteinMain) {
      // Straight run from off-screen left to the home position.
      // Opacity is left alone so Webflow's own value survives.
      // FLICKER FIX: visibility:'visible' in the FROM state — the element
      // is revealed on the same tick it is placed off-screen, never at home.
      einsteinIntro.fromTo(
        einsteinMain,
        { x: offscreenLeftX, y: '-50%', rotation: 20, visibility: 'visible' },
        {
          x: 0,
          y: 0,
          rotation: 0,
          duration: 3,
          ease: 'power3.out',
          immediateRender: false,
        },
        0,
      );
    }
    if (einstein) {
      // Flies in from beyond the left edge at the halfway point of
      // einsteinMain's 3s move (3 / 2 = 1.5), fading 0 → Webflow's 65%.
      einsteinIntro.fromTo(
        einstein,
        {
          x: function () {
            return -window.innerWidth;
          },
          y: 0,
          rotation: 0,
          opacity: 0,
        },
        { x: 0, y: 0, rotation: 0, opacity: EINSTEIN_OPACITY, duration: 1, ease: 'power3.out', immediateRender: false },
        1.5,
      );
    }

    // When the intro finishes, hand Einstein back to the scroll and let the
    // exit re-record its start values from the fresh home position.
    einsteinIntro.eventCallback('onComplete', function () {
      einsteinReturning = false;
      einsteinProxy.p = 0;
      einsteinExit.invalidate().progress(0);
      measureEinsteinMain();
    });

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // ONE entry point for the intro — used by BOTH the first page load and
    // the scroll-back-up re-entry, so the two behave identically.
    // restart() renders time 0 synchronously, so by the time this function
    // returns, both elements are already positioned off-screen AND revealed
    // — all inside one JS task, no frame can paint in between.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    function playEinsteinIntro() {
      einsteinReturning = true;
      gsap.killTweensOf(einsteinProxy); // stop the follower mid-flight
      parkEinsteinCloud(); // hide the cloud immediately + reveal element
      einsteinExit.invalidate(); // forget cached distances
      einsteinIntro.invalidate().restart(); // re-measure + play from the left
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Smoothing follower: scroll sets a target, this eases toward it and
    // feeds the eased value into the exit timeline. Raise duration for
    // an even softer, laggier feel.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    var einsteinProxy = { p: 0 };
    function driveEinsteinExit(target) {
      gsap.to(einsteinProxy, {
        p: target,
        duration: 1.2, // ← smoothness dial
        ease: 'power3.out',
        overwrite: true,
        onUpdate: function () {
          einsteinExit.progress(einsteinProxy.p);
        },
      });
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // NEWTON + FRANKLIN scrubbed timeline + the shared ScrollTrigger.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    var tl = gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: hero,

        // Start at the very first pixel of scroll — offset by the hero's
        // distance from the document top (~150px of banner + navbar).
        start: function () {
          return 'top top+=' + heroTopOffset();
        },

        // End after scrolling ~75% of the hero section's own height.
        // Tune the 0.75 multiplier: 0.70 = sooner, 0.80 = later.
        end: function () {
          return '+=' + hero.offsetHeight * 0.75;
        },

        scrub: 1, // Newton's + Franklin's smoothing
        invalidateOnRefresh: true, // re-measure on resize
        onUpdate: function (self) {
          if (!einsteinReturning) driveEinsteinExit(self.progress);
        },
        onEnterBack: function () {
          // scrolled back up into hero → play the intro
          playEinsteinIntro();
        },
        onLeave: function () {
          // scrolled back down mid-intro: abandon the half-played intro and
          // hand Einstein straight back to the scroll.
          if (!einsteinReturning) return;
          einsteinReturning = false;
          einsteinIntro.pause();
          einsteinExit.invalidate().progress(0); // re-record from live state → no jump
          einsteinProxy.p = 0;
          driveEinsteinExit(1);
        },
        // markers: true             // uncomment to debug start/end positions
      },
    });

    // Newton foreground: slide fully off the top + rotate to -30deg.
    if (newton) {
      tl.to(
        newton,
        {
          y: function () {
            return -(newton.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 120);
          },
          rotation: -30,
          duration: 1,
          ease: 'none',
        },
        0,
      );
    }
    // Newton parallax layer: rise by 3rem (spans the whole range)
    if (newtonMain) {
      tl.to(newtonMain, { y: '-3rem', duration: 1, ease: 'none' }, 0);
    }

    // Franklin foreground: fade only — 40% → 100% over the first 40%.
    if (franklin) {
      tl.to(franklin, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'none' }, 0);
    }
    // Franklin main: partial exit — 25% of the way toward the LEFT edge.
    if (franklinMain) {
      tl.to(
        franklinMain,
        {
          x: function () {
            return -franklinMain.getBoundingClientRect().right * 0.25;
          },
          duration: 1,
          ease: 'none',
        },
        0,
      );
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // FRANKLIN LOAD INTRO (client request): slight move to the RIGHT on
    // load. Animates xPercent while the scroll owns x — the two channels
    // compose independently, so they can never conflict.
    // FLICKER FIX: the element arrives pre-hidden by the head CSS.
    // fromTo renders its FROM state immediately (synchronously, right
    // here), so the element is revealed already nudged -4% left — it can
    // never flash at its home position first. Tune -4 for the nudge size.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    if (franklinMain) {
      gsap.fromTo(
        franklinMain,
        { xPercent: -4, visibility: 'visible' },
        { xPercent: 0, duration: 1.4, ease: 'power3.out' },
      );
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // EINSTEIN LOAD INTRO (client request): play the same intro once on
    // first page load, if the hero is still in view. If the page loads
    // already scrolled past the hero, the intro is skipped — but the
    // elements must STILL be revealed (they arrive pre-hidden by the head
    // CSS), placed straight into their scrolled-out exit state so nothing
    // flashes on screen; the scroll follower owns them from there.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    if (activeSet === 'einstein' && (einstein || einsteinMain)) {
      if (hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0) {
        // hero (at least partly) visible on load → full intro
        playEinsteinIntro();
      } else {
        // loaded past the hero → skip the intro, jump to the exited state,
        // then reveal. Both happen synchronously, so no flash is possible.
        einsteinProxy.p = 1;
        einsteinExit.progress(1);
        gsap.set([einstein, einsteinMain].filter(Boolean), { visibility: 'visible' });
      }
    }
  });

w-embed w-script"><style>
  .aadl_wrapper {
    --line: #1a2231;
    --line-soft: rgba(140, 170, 255, 0.14);
    --blue: #a6c8ff;
    --blue-bright: #5f96ff;
    --text: #e8edf5;
    --muted: #8b96a8;
    --muted-2: #5b6678;
    --D: 54vh;
    --edge: 9.375rem;
    --head-h: clamp(10.625rem, 20vh, 11.5625rem);
    /* Single easing curve, matching the prototype — smooth in/out, no snap. */
    --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.15, 1);
    --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
    --dur: 1.1s;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper button {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    font: inherit;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper a {
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node {
    font-size: 0;
  }

  /* ---------- the wheel ---------- */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel {
    transform: rotate(var(--rot, 0deg));
    transition: transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out);
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    padding: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.95), rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.2) 35%, rgba(80, 125, 210, 0.18) 60%, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.45) 100%);
    -webkit-mask:
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask-composite: exclude;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(95, 155, 245, 0.3));
    transform: rotate(calc(-1 * var(--rot, 0deg)));
    transition: transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 6vh;
    border-radius: 50%;
    padding: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.45), rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.06) 45%, rgba(80, 125, 210, 0.14) 75%, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.22) 100%);
    -webkit-mask:
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask-composite: exclude;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.4)) drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(95, 155, 245, 0.22));
    transform: rotate(calc(-1 * var(--rot, 0deg)));
    transition: transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* node angles around the wheel */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel .aadl_node:nth-child(1) {
    --a: 0deg;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel .aadl_node:nth-child(2) {
    --a: 44deg;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel .aadl_node:nth-child(3) {
    --a: 88deg;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel .aadl_node:nth-child(4) {
    --a: 132deg;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel .aadl_node:nth-child(5) {
    --a: 176deg;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel .aadl_node:nth-child(6) {
    --a: 220deg;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node {
    transform: rotate(var(--a)) translateX(calc(var(--D) / 2));
  }

  /* pill counter-rotates so its label always stays upright */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pill {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(calc(-1 * var(--a) - var(--rot, 0deg)));
    transition:
      transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out),
      padding 0.7s var(--ease-out),
      width 0.7s var(--ease-out),
      height 0.7s var(--ease-out),
      background 0.55s var(--ease-out) 0.1s,
      border-color 0.55s var(--ease-out) 0.1s,
      box-shadow 0.75s var(--ease-out) 0.15s,
      color 0.4s var(--ease-out);

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pill-text {

      max-width 0.6s var(--ease-out),
      opacity 0.25s var(--ease-out);
    max-width: 6.25rem;
    overflow: hidden;

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_ico {
    display: inline-flex;
    max-width: 0;
    opacity: 0;

    transition:
      max-width 0.5s var(--ease-out),
      opacity 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_ico svg {

    height: 1.25rem;

    transform: scale(0.4);

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node:hover .aadl_pill {
    color: var(--text);
    border-color: rgba(140, 170, 255, 0.4);
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node:focus-visible .aadl_pill {

  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pill::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7fc8ff, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.1) 45%, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.06) 62%, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.55) 100%);
    -webkit-mask:
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask-composite: exclude;
    opacity: 0;

  /* active stage collapses into the icon chip — its name moves to the panel header */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node.is-active .aadl_pill {
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    padding: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #16233a, #0b111d);
    border-color: transparent;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node.is-active .aadl_pill::after {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node.is-active .aadl_pill-text {
    max-width: 0;

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node.is-active .aadl_ico {
    max-width: 1.25rem;

  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_node.is-active .aadl_ico svg {

  /* connector: active chip -> panel, redrawn on every stage change */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_connector {

  @keyframes aadl-connector-draw {

  /* ---------- copy column: vertical carousel ---------- */
  /* Inactive panels park below (later stages) or above (earlier stages) so the

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_panel {
    opacity: 0;

    transition:
      opacity 0.25s var(--ease-out),
      transform 0.25s var(--ease-out);
  }
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_panel.is-above {
    transform: translateY(-2.75rem);

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_panel.is-active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
    transition:
      opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out) 0.075s,
      transform 0.5s var(--ease-out) 0.075s;
  }

  /* ---------- visual column: same carousel (centered on top:50%) ---------- */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot {
    opacity: 0;

    transition:

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot.is-above {

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot.is-active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1);
    pointer-events: auto;

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    padding: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.9) 0%, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.25) 30%, rgba(90, 140, 220, 0.16) 68%, rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.5) 100%);
    -webkit-mask:
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,
      linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
    mask-composite: exclude;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.35)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(95, 155, 245, 0.2));
    pointer-events: none;

  /* feature list + chips (kept for compatibility; harmless if unused) */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_feats-item::before {

    position: absolute;
    left: 2px;
    top: 0.52em;
    width: 6px;

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_feats-item b {

      border-color 0.2s,

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_chip:hover {

  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_chip:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--blue-bright);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  /* inline shot — hidden by default, shown only on tablet/mobile */
  .aadl_shot--inline {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ---------- heading: allow wrap on all widths ----------
   Designer's .aadl_heading uses `white-space:nowrap`, which overflows below
   ~1400px. This lets it wrap so it never breaks out of the container. */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_heading {
    white-space: normal !important;
  }

  /* Two-line title on large screens (1440px+): the script injects a <br> after
   "Accelerating the"; this toggles it — off (single flow) below 1440, on above. */
  .aadl_wrapper .aadl_heading .aadl_heading-br {
    display: none;
  }
  @media (min-width: 1440px) {
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_heading .aadl_heading-br {
      display: inline;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- MOBILE / TABLET (max 991px) ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 991px) {
    .aadl_wrapper {
      height: auto !important;
      overflow: visible !important;
    }

      position: static !important;
      height: auto !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;

      pointer-events: auto !important;

    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pin .aadl_header .aadl_heading {

      justify-self: start !important;
      align-self: start !important;

    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel-wrap,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel-wrap .aadl_connector,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_visual,

      display: none !important;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_chips {

     inherited from the base .aadl_shot rules. We only reflow it into the column,

    .aadl_shot--inline {
      display: block !important;
      position: relative !important;
      transform: none !important;
      inset: auto !important;
      top: auto !important;
      right: auto !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      max-height: none !important;
      aspect-ratio: auto !important;
      margin: 2rem 0 2.5rem !important;
      opacity: 0.25 !important;
      transition: opacity 0.25s var(--ease-in-out) !important;

      height: auto !important;

      display: block !important;
      margin: 0 !important;

  /* ---------- SHORT / NARROW DESKTOP — keep the pinned design, stop the overlap ----------
   The pinned layout puts the section title in an absolutely-positioned header
   that reserves a FIXED height (--head-h). On narrow desktops the big title
   wraps to two lines and grows taller than that reserve, so it overlapped the
   stage copy; on short viewports the vertically-centred copy also overflowed and
   the buttons got cut off.
   Fix: on narrow (≤1500px) OR short (≤860px) desktops, switch the pin to a flex
   column. The header then takes its TRUE height (wraps freely, never overlaps)
   and the body fills whatever height is left. Wide + tall desktops are untouched,
   so the original design is unchanged where it already fits. */
  /* ---------- DESKTOP (≥992px): make the pinned header self-sizing ----------
   The pinned layout reserved a FIXED header height (--head-h). When the title
   wraps to two lines (narrow screens, or the forced 1440px+ break) it grows
   taller than that reserve and overlapped the stage copy. Turning the pin into
   a flex column lets the header take its TRUE height and the body fill the rest
   — no overlap at any width or height. */
  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pin {
      display: flex !important;
      flex-direction: column !important;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pin .aadl_header {
      position: relative !important;
      inset: auto !important;
      top: auto !important;
      flex: 0 0 auto !important;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_body {
      position: relative !important;
      inset: auto !important;
      top: auto !important;
      flex: 1 1 auto !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;
    }
    /* the visual never forces extra height */
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot {
      max-height: 80vh !important;
    }
  }

  /* On genuinely short viewports also trim the header padding + section title a
   touch and cap the visual, so the stage copy and its buttons fit without being
   clipped. This is the only spot that touches a font-size (title only, never the
   stage/lead) — delete this block if you'd rather size the title from Webflow. */
  @media (min-width: 992px) and (max-height: 820px) {
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pin .aadl_header {
      padding-top: 1.25rem !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_heading {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) !important;
      line-height: 1.12 !important;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot {
      max-height: 64vh !important;
    }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .aadl_wrapper {
      scroll-behavior: auto;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_connector {
      animation: none;
    }
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_pill,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_panel,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_shot,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_ico,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel::before,
    .aadl_wrapper .aadl_wheel::after {
      transition: none;
    }
    .aadl_shot--inline {
      transition: none !important;
    }
  }

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var STAGES = ['Build', 'Test', 'Deploy', 'Monitor', 'Iterate', 'Govern'];
    var STEP = 44; // degrees between wheel nodes
    var MOBILE_MQ = '(max-width: 991px)';
    var MOBILE_LOCK_MS = 1500;

    var sec = document.querySelector('.aadl_wrapper');
    if (!sec) return;
    // Guard against double-initialisation (e.g. the embed accidentally added
    // twice). Two copies of this script would attach two sets of listeners and
    // two IntersectionObservers to the same nodes, which is what makes the
    // buttons/panels flicker as they enter.
    if (sec.getAttribute('data-aadl-init')) return;
    sec.setAttribute('data-aadl-init', '1');

    var wheel = sec.querySelector('.aadl_wheel');
    var nodes = [].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.aadl_node'));
    var panels = [].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.aadl_panel'));
    var shots = [].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.aadl_visual .aadl_shot')); // desktop crossfade (6)
    var mdots = [].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.aadl_mprog-dot'));
    var mlabel = sec.querySelector('.aadl_mprog-label');
    var conn = sec.querySelector('.aadl_connector');
    var pillbar = document.querySelector('.platform-lc_mobile-pillbar');
    var pillrow = document.querySelector('.platform-lc_mobile-pillrow');
    var mpills = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.platform-lc_mobile-pill'));
    var reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    var mq = matchMedia(MOBILE_MQ);
    var current = -1;
    var inlineShots = [];

    // --- Stage lock ---
    // When the user taps a pill/panel we freeze the observer until the smooth
    // scroll settles, so the IntersectionObserver can't briefly reassign the
    // stage to whatever panel still fills the viewport mid-scroll (the
    // "flashes to the previous pill first" bug).
    var lockedIndex = null,
      lockTimer = null;
    function lockStage(i, ms) {
      lockedIndex = i;
      if (lockTimer) clearTimeout(lockTimer);
      lockTimer = setTimeout(releaseStageLock, ms || MOBILE_LOCK_MS);
    }
    function releaseStageLock() {
      if (lockTimer) {
        clearTimeout(lockTimer);
        lockTimer = null;
      }
      lockedIndex = null;
    }

    // Wheel icon shown inside the active pill. The .aadl_ico elements built in the

</style></div><div class="hide w-embed w-script"><script>
  const strokesSvg = document.getElementById('strokes-svg');
  const logoWrap = document.querySelector('.logo-wrap');
  const footer = document.querySelector('.v2-footer');

  // Tune these
  const RADIUS_RATIO = 0.18; // radius = 18% of logo width (scales on mobile)
  const SMOOTHING = 0.12; // 0 = frozen, 1 = instant. Lower = smoother/slower.

  let targetX = null;
  let currentX = null;
  let rafId = null;

  function computeTarget() {
    const logoRect = logoWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const footerRect = footer.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vh = window.innerHeight;

    const radius = logoRect.width * RADIUS_RATIO;
    const START_OFFSET = logoRect.height * 0.1;

    const totalRange = footerRect.bottom - logoRect.top - START_OFFSET;
    const scrolled = vh - logoRect.top - START_OFFSET;
    const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, scrolled / totalRange));

    targetX = -radius + progress * logoRect.width;

    // Initialize currentX on first run so there's no jump-in
    if (currentX === null) currentX = targetX;

    return { radius, y: logoRect.height / 2 };
  }

  function applyMask(x, y, radius) {
    const grad = `radial-gradient(${radius}px at ${x}px ${y}px, black 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 100%)`;
    strokesSvg.style.webkitMaskImage = grad;
    strokesSvg.style.maskImage = grad;
  }

  function tick() {
    const { radius, y } = computeTarget();

    // Ease currentX toward targetX
    currentX += (targetX - currentX) * SMOOTHING;

    applyMask(currentX, y, radius);

    // Keep animating until we're essentially at the target
    if (Math.abs(targetX - currentX) > 0.3) {
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    } else {
      currentX = targetX;
      applyMask(currentX, y, radius);
      rafId = null;
    }
  }

  function onScroll() {
    if (rafId === null) {
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
  tick(); // set initial state

  // Debounce function to limit the rate at which a function is executed
  function debounce(func, wait) {
    let timeout;
    return function executedFunction(...args) {
      const later = () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        func(...args);
      };
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
    };
  }

  // Function to update video sources
  function updateVideoSources() {

<script>
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  // Shared animation factory
  function animateLetters(el, { scrollTrigger, delay, colors, durations, stagger }) {
    const { chars } = new SplitType(el, { types: "words, chars" });

    // Set initial state
    if (typeof colors.initial === "function") {
      chars.forEach((char) => {
        const c = colors.initial(char);
        gsap.set(char, { opacity: 0.3, color: c });
      });
    } else {
      gsap.set(chars, { opacity: 0.3, color: colors.initial });
    }

    if (delay !== undefined) gsap.set(el, { opacity: 1 });

    const tl = gsap.timeline(scrollTrigger ? { scrollTrigger } : { delay: delay ?? 0 });

    chars.forEach((char, i) => {
      const highlight = typeof colors.highlight === "function" ? colors.highlight(char) : colors.highlight;
      const base = typeof colors.base === "function" ? colors.base(char) : colors.base;
      const offset = i * stagger;

      tl.to(char, {
        opacity: 1,
        color: highlight,
        textShadow: "0 0 12px rgba(127, 200, 255, 0.6)",
        duration: durations[0],
        ease: durations[2] || undefined,
      }, offset).to(char, {
        color: base,
        textShadow: "none",
        duration: durations[1],
        ease: durations[2] || undefined,
      }, offset + durations[0]);
    });
  }

  const scrollConfig = (el, scrub = 0.3) => ({

  /**
   * LangChain platform section — scroll-driven lifecycle animation.
   *
   * How it works:
   *  1. Ring rotation is a FUNCTION OF SCROLL POSITION, not a separate
   *     timer-based tween. Cards, ring and screenshots therefore cannot drift
   *     apart or briefly run backwards.
   *  2. Pills are laid out LINEARLY — no carousel wrap-around. Stages before
   *     the active one move up the arc, stages after it move down, and
   *     anything out of range fades out. On "Govern" there is nothing below
   *     "Iterate", and on "Build" there is nothing above it.
   *  3. Pill positions are written to `transform` (compositor) rather than
   *     `left/top` (which would force a reflow every frame).
   *  4. A single rAF loop instead of several competing animations.
   *  5. Custom eased scrolling on click — fixed duration regardless of
   *     distance, interrupted by wheel / touch input.
   *  6. "Iterate" is a full stage on the ring (5 pills). Between monitor and
   *     iterate the ring performs a complete revolution and settles with
   *     "Iterate" active.
   *
   * A pill's stage index comes from its data-pill attribute (the stage name),
   * so DOM order and data-pill-index are irrelevant.
   *
   * On mobile (<= 991px) the orbit is hidden via CSS — the active stage is
   * driven by an IntersectionObserver instead.
   */
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    // --- Root + child elements -------------------------------------------------
    const section = document.querySelector('.section_platform-langchain');
    if (!section) return;

    const stickyColumn = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_left');
    const cardsWrap = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_cards');
    const header = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_header');
    const cards = [...section.querySelectorAll('.platform-lc_card')];
    const allPills = [...section.querySelectorAll('.platform-lc_pill')];
    const mobilePills = [...section.querySelectorAll('.platform-lc_mobile-pill')];
    const shots = [...section.querySelectorAll('.platform-lc_shot')];
    const governRing = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_govern-ring');
    const orbitRing = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_orbit-ring');
    // Everything that should light up on the "govern" stage: the pill wrapper,
    // the icon label, and so on. Matched through several selectors so renaming
    // a class in Webflow does not silently break the script.
    const governEls = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-govern-label], .platform-lc_govern, .platform-lc_govern-label')];
    const connector = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_connector');
    const mobilePillRow = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_mobile-pillrow');
    const orbitAnchor = section.querySelector('.platform-lc_orbit-anchor');

    if (!stickyColumn || !cardsWrap) return;

    // --- Stage model -----------------------------------------------------------
    // "iterate" is a full stage on the ring and owns a pill.
    // "govern" sits outside the orbit (outer ring + label).
    const ORBIT_STAGES = ['build', 'test', 'deploy', 'monitor', 'iterate'];
    const ALL_STAGES = ['build', 'test', 'deploy', 'monitor', 'iterate', 'govern'];
    const ORBIT_COUNT = ORBIT_STAGES.length;
    const LAST_STAGE = ALL_STAGES.length - 1;

    // The full revolution happens across the monitor -> iterate segment.
    const SPIN_FROM = ALL_STAGES.indexOf('monitor');
    const SPIN_TO = ALL_STAGES.indexOf('iterate');

    // --- Orbit geometry (percentages inside .platform-lc_orbit-anchor) ---------
    const CENTER_X = 132.5;
    const CENTER_Y = 50;
    const RADIUS_X = 50;
    const RADIUS_Y = 50;
    const STAGE_SPACING_DEG = 72;

    /**
     * Pill visibility range.
     *
     * The model is LINEAR — pills never wrap into a carousel. The offset is
     * simply (rotation - index): stages before the active one travel up the
     * arc, stages after it travel down, and anything beyond the range fades
     * out and slides off frame.
     */
    const VISIBLE_SPAN = 4.0; // fully opaque up to this offset
    const FADE_BAND = 1.5; // fades to zero across the next 0.6 of offset
    const EDGE_SCALE = 0.86; // pill scale at the moment it disappears

    // --- Tuning ----------------------------------------------------------------
    const SPIN_TURNS = 1; // full revolutions performed when entering "iterate"
    const SMOOTHING = 0.22; // 1 = no smoothing, lower = more trailing
    const CLICK_SCROLL_MS = 700; // scroll duration after clicking a card or pill
    const SHOT_DELAY_MS = 120; // screenshot swap lag behind the card / ring

    // fallback — `scrollend` and manual input release the lock sooner.
    const MOBILE_LOCK_MS = 1200;

    const mobileQuery = matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');
    const reducedMotion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

    let targetProgress = 0; // raw scroll progress, 0..1
    let currentProgress = 0; // smoothed progress — everything renders from this

    let rafId = 0;
    let lastFrame = 0;

    let scrollAnim = null; // cancellation token for the click-driven scroll

    // the highlight snaps back to the previous stage before landing on the
    // requested one — the flicker on every mobile pill tap.

    let lockTimer = null;

    let anchorH = 0;
    let cardOffsets = [];

     * section approaches the viewport, promote any that have not loaded yet.

    function warmShots() {

      shots.forEach((shot) => {

    function paintPill(pill, index, rotation, spin) {
      // No wrapping — the offset grows linearly with distance from the active
      // stage, so a pill never reappears from the opposite end of the arc.
      const offset = rotation - index;

      }
      const angleRad = ((180 + offset * STAGE_SPACING_DEG + spin) * Math.PI) / 180;

      // to avoid touching the style object every frame.

    }

    // --- Stage activation (classes + screenshot only) --------------------------
    function setActiveStage(stage) {
      if (stage === activeStage) return;
      activeStage = stage;
      activeIndex = Math.max(0, ALL_STAGES.indexOf(stage));

      cards.forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle('is-active', c.getAttribute('data-stage') === stage));

      const transform = 'translate3d(0,' + y.toFixed(2) + 'px,0)';
      cardsWrap.style.transform = transform;
      if (header) header.style.transform = transform;

      // Orbit. Rotation is ABSOLUTE (never a "shortest path"), so the direction
      // of travel always matches the scroll direction.
      if (anchorW && anchorH) {
        const rotation = clamp(eased, 0, ORBIT_COUNT - 1);

        // Full revolution when entering "iterate". Scroll-driven, so scrolling
        // back up unwinds it — there is no half-finished spin left hanging.
        const spinSpan = Math.max(1, SPIN_TO - SPIN_FROM);
        const spin = SPIN_TURNS * 360 * clamp((eased - SPIN_FROM) / spinSpan, 0, 1);
        orbitPills.forEach((pill, i) => paintPill(pill, pillIndex[i], rotation, spin));
      }

      // Active stage with hysteresis, which stops classes flickering when the
      // scroll position jitters around a boundary.
      let want = activeIndex;
      if (stagePos >= activeIndex + 0.5 + STAGE_HYSTERESIS) want = clamp(Math.round(stagePos), 0, LAST_STAGE);
      else if (stagePos <= activeIndex - 0.5 - STAGE_HYSTERESIS) want = clamp(Math.round(stagePos), 0, LAST_STAGE);
      if (want !== activeIndex) setActiveStage(ALL_STAGES[want]);
    }

    // --- Loop ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function tick(now) {
      rafId = 0;
      const dt = clamp(now - (lastFrame || now - 16.7), 1, 64);
      lastFrame = now;

      if (SMOOTHING >= 1 || reducedMotion.matches) {
        currentProgress = targetProgress;
      } else {
        const k = 1 - Math.pow(1 - SMOOTHING, dt / 16.667);
        currentProgress += (targetProgress - currentProgress) * k;
        if (Math.abs(targetProgress - currentProgress) < 0.00015) currentProgress = targetProgress;
      }

      render();
      if (currentProgress !== targetProgress) schedule();
    }

    function schedule() {
      if (rafId) return;
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    function readProgress() {
      const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      const span = rect.height - viewportH;
      if (span <= 0) return null;
      return clamp(-rect.top / span, 0, 1);
    }

    function onScroll() {
      if (mobileQuery.matches || !inView) return;
      const p = readProgress();
      if (p === null) return;
      targetProgress = p;
      schedule();
    }

    // --- Mobile layout ---------------------------------------------------------
    function applyMobileLayout() {
      cardsWrap.style.transform = '';
      if (header) header.style.transform = '';
    }

    // --- Click-driven scrolling ------------------------------------------------
    function cancelScrollAnim() {
      if (scrollAnim) scrollAnim.cancelled = true;
      scrollAnim = null;
    }

    function animateScrollTo(top, duration) {
      cancelScrollAnim();

      if (reducedMotion.matches || duration <= 0) {
        scrollTo(0, top);
        return;
      }

      const from = scrollY;
      const delta = top - from;
      if (Math.abs(delta) < 1) return;

      const token = { cancelled: false };
      scrollAnim = token;
      const start = performance.now();

      (function step(now) {
        if (token.cancelled) return;
        const p = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
        scrollTo(0, from + delta * easeInOutCubic(p));
        if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        else if (scrollAnim === token) scrollAnim = null;
      })(performance.now());
    }

    function scrollToStage(index) {
      const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      const span = rect.height - viewportH;
      if (span <= 0) return;
      const t = LAST_STAGE <= 0 ? 0 : clamp(index, 0, LAST_STAGE) / LAST_STAGE;
      animateScrollTo(Math.round(scrollY + rect.top + t * span), CLICK_SCROLL_MS);
    }

    function activateStageByIndex(index) {
      if (mobileQuery.matches) {
        const card = cards[index];
        // Claim the stage before scrolling. The observer is suppressed for the
        // duration, so the highlight goes straight to the tapped stage instead
        // of bouncing through the one that is still filling the viewport.
        lockStage(ALL_STAGES[index], MOBILE_LOCK_MS);
        if (card) card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reducedMotion.matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        setActiveStage(ALL_STAGES[index]);
        return;
      }
      scrollToStage(index);
    }

    function activateStageByName(stage) {
      const index = ALL_STAGES.indexOf(stage);
      if (index !== -1) activateStageByIndex(index);
      else setActiveStage(stage);
    }

    // --- Mapping pills to stage indices ----------------------------------------
    // Only pills whose data-pill is an orbit stage get positioned. "Govern"
    // has its own spot next to the outer ring and is placed purely with CSS —
    // the script never touches its transform.
    const orbitPills = allPills.filter((p) => ORBIT_STAGES.indexOf(p.getAttribute('data-pill')) !== -1);
    const pillIndex = orbitPills.map((pill) => ORBIT_STAGES.indexOf(pill.getAttribute('data-pill')));

    // --- Event wiring ----------------------------------------------------------
    cards.forEach((card, index) => card.addEventListener('click', () => activateStageByIndex(index)));

    allPills.forEach((pill) =>
      pill.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        activateStageByName(pill.getAttribute('data-pill'));
      }),
    );

    mobilePills.forEach((pill) =>
      pill.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        activateStageByName(pill.getAttribute('data-mobile-pill'));
      }),
    );

    if (governRing) governRing.addEventListener('click', () => activateStageByName('govern'));
    governEls.forEach((el) => el.addEventListener('click', () => activateStageByName('govern')));

    addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });

    // Native scrollend where available, so the lock lifts the moment the
    // smooth scroll actually settles rather than waiting out MOBILE_LOCK_MS.
    if ('onscrollend' in window) {
      addEventListener('scrollend', releaseStageLock, { passive: true });
    }

    // Manual input means the user is driving again — hand control back at once.
    // `touchmove`, not `touchstart`: a tap on a pill fires touchstart BEFORE
    // the click handler runs, which would release the lock before it is even
    // taken. Only an actual drag should override the tap.
    ['wheel', 'touchmove'].forEach((type) => addEventListener(type, releaseStageLock, { passive: true }));

    // Manual scrolling cancels the click animation. Without this the two fight
    // over scrollTop and the page stutters.
    ['wheel', 'touchstart', 'keydown'].forEach((type) => addEventListener(type, cancelScrollAnim, { passive: true }));

    let resizeTimer = null;
    addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (resizeTimer) clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        measure();
        if (mobileQuery.matches) applyMobileLayout();
        else onScroll();
        schedule();
      }, 120);
    });

    // Nothing is computed while the section is off screen.
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries) => {
          inView = entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting);
          if (inView) {
            warmShots();
            measure();
            onScroll();
          }
        },
        { rootMargin: '10% 0px 10% 0px' },
      ).observe(section);
    }

    // Lazily loaded images can change card heights after first paint.
    addEventListener('load', () => {
      measure();
      onScroll();
      schedule();
    });

    if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
      let first = true;
      new ResizeObserver(() => {
        if (first) {
          first = false;
          return;
        }
        measure();
        onScroll();
        schedule();
      }).observe(cardsWrap);
    }

    // On mobile the active stage is whichever card fills most of the viewport.
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
        () => {
          if (!mobileQuery.matches) return;
          // A tap has claimed a stage and the scroll has not landed yet —
          // whatever is most visible right now is stale, so ignore it.
          if (lockedStage) return;

          let best = null;
          let bestRatio = 0;
          cards.forEach((card) => {
            const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
            const visible = Math.max(0, Math.min(rect.bottom, viewportH) - Math.max(rect.top, 0));
            const ratio = card.offsetHeight ? visible / card.offsetHeight : 0;
            if (ratio > bestRatio) {
              bestRatio = ratio;
              best = card;
            }
          });

          const stage = best && best.getAttribute('data-stage');
          if (stage) setActiveStage(stage);
        },
        { root: null, rootMargin: '-25% 0px -35% 0px', threshold: [0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9] },
      );
      cards.forEach((card) => observer.observe(card));
    }

    mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
      releaseStageLock();
      measure();
      if (mobileQuery.matches) applyMobileLayout();
      else onScroll();
      schedule();
    });

    // --- Init ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Pills are placed with transform, so left/top are zeroed out once here.
    orbitPills.forEach((pill) => {
      pill.style.left = '0px';
      pill.style.top = '0px';
      pill.style.willChange = 'transform, opacity';
    });

    measure();

    if (mobileQuery.matches) {
      applyMobileLayout();
    } else {
      const p = readProgress();
      targetProgress = currentProgress = p === null ? 0 : p;
      render();
    }
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    var mq = matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');
    var moved = false;
    function moveShots() {
      if (moved || !mq.matches) return;
      document.querySelectorAll('.platform-lc_card').forEach(function (card) {
        var stage = card.getAttribute('data-stage');
        var shot = document.querySelector('.platform-lc_shot[data-shot="' + stage + '"]');
        if (shot) card.appendChild(shot);
      });
      moved = true;
    }
    moveShots();
    mq.addEventListener('change', moveShots);
  })();
</script><script src="https://hubspotonwebflow.com/assets/js/form-124.js" type="text/javascript" integrity="sha384-bjyNIOqAKScdeQ3THsDZLGagNN56B4X2Auu9YZIGu+tA/PlggMk4jbWruG/P6zYj" crossorigin="anonymous"></script></body></html>
